in_hebrew.name: Kiril
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kiril הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'kirios' meaning 'lord' or 'sovereign'. In Christian contexts, the name Kiril is associated with St. Cyril of Alexandria, a prominent theologian and bishop in early Christianity.
